plain_language_definition: Prepared exercise title.
limitations_or_cautions: Names can contain natural anatomical terms; a title does not verify instructions.

plain_language_definition: Available instructional text retained from the cleaned source.
limitations_or_cautions: Missing text stays missing; text presence is not source or youth-suitability verification.

plain_language_definition: Source body-part category in standardized formatting.
limitations_or_cautions: Single source labels remain subject to review and are excluded from classifier input construction.

plain_language_definition: Recorded equipment, difficulty, and exercise type.
limitations_or_cautions: These fields are outside the current classifier feature contract; literal equipment none is distinct from unknown.

plain_language_definition: Exercise name and available description joined with a paragraph break.
limitations_or_cautions: No target-bearing agent text, goal tags, identifiers, or review fields are appended.

plain_language_definition: Stable reference to one position in the verified cleaned exercise file.
limitations_or_cautions: A changed or reordered parent requires explicit reconciliation; identifiers are not model inputs.

plain_language_definition: Connected records retained together for later dataset partitioning.
limitations_or_cautions: Groups do not establish canonical identity or statistical independence; per-label group counts can overlap.

plain_language_definition: Recorded label-review state, observed findings, and preliminary name-and-label candidacy.
limitations_or_cautions: Candidacy and handled findings do not establish approval for youth recommendations.

plain_language_definition: Reference-food identifier, description, and recorded food-data type.
limitations_or_cautions: Confirm food identity and reference amount before serving calculations.

plain_language_definition: Recorded protein, fat, carbohydrate, and fiber amounts in grams.
limitations_or_cautions: Finite nonnegative analysis views preserve missing, invalid, nonfinite, and negative source values separately.

plain_language_definition: Alternative recorded energy estimates and the selected estimate with its method.
limitations_or_cautions: Selected energy can depend on these source fields and on macronutrients; correlation is not an athlete-outcome result.

plain_language_definition: Imported occurrence identifier, activity name, skill label, and curriculum level.
limitations_or_cautions: Occurrences, normalized names, and approved distinct drills are separate counting units.

plain_language_definition: Recorded activity prescription, equipment, and participant arrangement.
limitations_or_cautions: Prescription text can describe minutes, repetitions, or other units; numeric durations and participant minima are not inferred.

plain_language_definition: Recorded source reference and proposed solo adaptation.
limitations_or_cautions: Metadata and adaptations require source review; their presence is not publisher endorsement.

plain_language_definition: Text document derived from an imported activity and linked by its identifier.
limitations_or_cautions: This is a representation of existing activity metadata, not an independent drill or coaching source.

plain_language_definition: Reference-rule identifier, measured concept, population segment, rule form, and unit.
limitations_or_cautions: Reference rules are not observed recovery outcomes or activated planner constraints.

plain_language_definition: Recorded age, school-grade, or numerical boundaries where applicable.
limitations_or_cautions: Blank bounds can be intentional; age and grade segments must be reconciled in Step 13.

plain_language_definition: Recorded evidence link and verification wording.
limitations_or_cautions: Recorded verification wording does not establish individual applicability or approval by this analysis.

plain_language_definition: Recovery topic, reference wording, and its recorded source.
limitations_or_cautions: These records do not contain measured athlete recovery outcomes.

plain_language_definition: Index identifier, record domain, linked source file, and position in its cleaned source.
limitations_or_cautions: Cleaned-file positions are not original publisher identifiers; rows from different domains are not interchangeable samples.

plain_language_definition: Display label, prepared retrieval text, and structured source payload.
limitations_or_cautions: These fields do not form a shared supervised target; existing agent text is outside the exercise feature contract.

plain_language_definition: Identifier and synthetic marker where available.
limitations_or_cautions: The two fictional sources stay separate; final-test independence has not been established.

plain_language_definition: Generated age, sport, playing position, and experience.
limitations_or_cautions: Distributions describe example design rather than athlete prevalence.

plain_language_definition: Recorded objective and number of available days.
limitations_or_cautions: Available days do not establish session length, other commitments, or total workload.

plain_language_definition: Recorded equipment and fictional reported injury state.
limitations_or_cautions: Reported none remains separate from unknown; a reported condition is not a diagnosis or clearance.

plain_language_definition: Generated scenario labels, requests, and explanatory notes.
limitations_or_cautions: Annotations are development inputs, not independent outcomes or evaluator scores.
